summary: The camera group has 83 files in five partitions (vendor_a 57, system_a 12, system_ext_a 6, odm_a 4, product_a 4). Its core is a QTI Camera HAL3 module (vendor_a/lib64/hw/camera.qcom.so, hw_module id "camera", module API 3.0) that loads CHI pipeline and 3A/statistics component libraries from vendor_a/lib64/camera/components; an XR camera HAL implementation (vendor_a/lib64/libxrcamerahal.so) is reached through an odm shim (odm_a/lib64/libcamerahal.so exporting CameraHalC_Init/Start/Stop/Deinit). A camera mux-mode service family (system_ext cameramuxmodeservice daemon, a client monitor library, a JSON reader library and a command-line client) is configured by /product/etc/cameramuxmode/config.json (v1) and by configv2.json (version 3), which is duplicated in vendor_a and read by the odm sensor service. The CAMERA_ICP firmware is an Xtensa ELF32 MDT image with 21 program headers, 13 of whose segment files carry data. vendor_a/etc/camera holds 16 tuning and sensor-module blobs (Chromatix headers, AEC/AWB tables, CVA and depth AE JSON) for IMX471, OG01A1B and OV7251 sensors, and system_a holds framework and HIDL client libraries (camera.common@1.0, camera.device@3.2, camera2 NDK, camera client, camera metadata) in 32-bit and 64-bit builds. Init references in the mounted partitions name only cameramuxmodeservice; SELinux labels cover the mux-mode service, its config directory and properties, and the firmware directory.
